individuals with folate deficiency anemia (Stauder et al., 2018). Anemia associated with both of these deficiencies 
can be distinguished from IDA based on the size of red blood cells; iron deficiency anemia is microcytic, whereas 
folate and vitamin B12 deficiencies are macrocytic. Treatment is focused on nutrient replacement and diet 
modification.
